lines: Any A.I. can check your email.
It sweeps your inboxes, reads what matters, and drafts replies in your voice.
It checks your pipeline and tells you exactly what's still pending.
It answers your phone, and follows up so nothing slips.
And nothing sends without your okay.
Jordyn arrives already knowing your industry — no setup, no prompt engineering.
It's the assistant with a brain for your business.
